Cadastral survey map of the square bounded by 13th St. N.W., D St. N.W., 12th St. N.W., and C St. N.W. in central Washington D.C. (square 293).

Cadastral survey map of the square bounded by 13th St. N.W., D St. N.W., 12th St. N.W., and C St. N.W. in central Washington D.C. (square 293). Shows lot lines, lot and alley dimensions, and lot numbers. In text at bottom: Witness our hands this 5th day of October 1792. At lower left in handwriting: Witness for the Commissioners--Thos. Orme, Jno. Mounty Jr. for David Burns. Pen-and-ink with lead pencil annotations. Sheet originally folded to 21 x 9 cm. Watermark: J. Robeson, P[hi]la. Imperfect: Torn at fold lines, lightly stained, missing sections at edges and fold lines (including small portions of plat and text). Includes inset map of 2 lots and handwritten texts. Ms. pencil and ink annotations on verso. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Gift; Samuel A. Bleicher, Arlington, VA; July 2002. DCP Acquisitions control no.: 2003-31
Contributors: Carroll, Daniel, 1764-1849; District of Columbia. Board of Commissioners; Stuart, David, 1753-1811
